findings.title: [P1] Preserve tenant isolation when authorizing document reads
findings.body: Returning true unconditionally allows users to read documents belonging to any tenant, replacing the prior tenant-equality authorization check and causing a cross-tenant data-access vulnerability.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant ownership check
findings.body: When callers use this function to authorize document reads, returning `true` unconditionally permits a user from one tenant to read another tenant's document. The full PR diff shows that line 2 removes the prior `userTenant === documentTenant` enforcement, and no alternative trusted-administrator restriction is encoded at this boundary.
